section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses theoretical frameworks for assessing well-being in relation to body image, distinguishing between life satisfaction and subjective happiness as components of subjective well-being. The authors review prior research showing associations between women's body image and life satisfaction, and note that no previous study has examined the relationship between body image and subjective happiness. This is a conceptual/literature review section with no original empirical study data presented.
